description: LifeFrom is a beta iPhone application for integrating and exploring personal biological and health data. It supports importing consumer raw genotype files from 23andMe, AncestryDNA and MyHeritage, blood-test panels and microbiome reports, alongside Apple Health measurements. It organizes these inputs into a longitudinal record and presents genetic variant summaries, biomarker trends and contextual report explanations. Access is offered through an iPhone beta, advertised as free during the beta period. The public website includes illustrative demonstrations.
name: LifeFrom
